item.title: Version 2.8
item.description:
iPod Drop 2.8

  • Now Playing. Click the song in the player bar for a full-window player: big cover art over a blurred backdrop, the song's details, large controls, and Up Next and Info panels. The toolbar hides and the controls fade while you listen; Esc closes it.
  • Your iPod at a glance. Click the iPod at the top of the sidebar to see its details, how its storage is used, and your listening patterns: time listened, top genres and decades, time of day, what's on repeat, forgotten favourites and your top artists.
  • Never Played and On Repeat. Turn on live playlists in Settings, or click Sync at the bottom of the sidebar: songs you haven't heard yet, and the 50 you play most. The iPod keeps them up to date as you listen.
  • Suggestions as you type. Artist, Album, Album Artist, Genre and Composer in the Info panel suggest names already on your iPod, so spellings stay consistent.
  • Clearer Info panel. Labels and values line up, Track and Disc read "1 of 12", and empty fields show what to add.
  • See what's playing. The playing song stands out in song lists with a moving sound icon.
